page.layout: One text column in the centre of the page, with four short marginal notes on the right beside lines 9–13. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Signature bottom left, catchword bottom right.

main_text.p: tebris procul Nicæa conditos, ac confarcinatos. Itaque prohibet natalium obscuritas, atque infelicitas, quominus isti canones in hac testium quarti, quintique sæculi luce consistere vel possint, vel debeant:

4. Sed & in hoc apocryphorum testium censu merito collocanda est illa jam olim à Gratiano inauspicata laudata Hieronymi ad Damasum epistola, ex qua hæc pro suis Canonibus recitat Turrianus {a}a; Quod autem beatitudo tua quæsivit, utrum usus decimarum & oblationum sæcularibus provenire possit, novit tua sanctitas omnino non recta licere, protestantibus hoc divinis authoritatibus paternorum Canonum. Hactenus Gratianus. Sed hæc epistola spuria est, & ab Hieronymi ingenio plane aliena; neque ulla earum epistolarum, quæ ab eo ad Damasum scriptæ extant, aut uspiam alibi in omnibus, quæ habemus, Hieronymi operibus hæc verba leguntur; quod & ipsi Gregoriani Gratianei decreti correctores ad hunc ejus locum annotarunt, Pars (inquit) hujus capitis citatur ex B. Hieronymo, in cujus quæ extant, scriptis nihil hujusmodi inventum est. Sane eam, quæ circumfertur Hieronymi ad Damasum de oblationibus altaris epistolam, ex qua hæc verba desumpta esse probabile est (tametsi hodie nulla in ea legantur) notham esse,a c. 16.q. 1. extr.Turr. c. 21. v. 65.

page.notes: The marginal notes sit at the right beside the Turrianus paragraph; the reference mark "a" is the italic letter after Turrianus. The second and third margin notes have no printed letter mark. The printed underlined Q of "Quod" is not reproduced. Long s has been normalised to s; the "Ii 2" signature reads as printed.
